#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Build backstage/workshop.html ("Inside the workshop") from the factory's own files.

Every number on the page is read from disk: the course's pipeline outputs, the run state,
FLIGHT-LOG.md, and the lesson pages at the staging and legacy refs. Re-run after a ship.

usage: factory.py [--site ~/Developer/ordenacoes-filipinas] [--data ~/Developer/ordenacoes-filipinas-workshop]
  --data is the checkout holding the git-ignored pipeline text (chapters/, compendium/*.txt).
"""
import argparse, csv, datetime, glob, html, json, os, re, subprocess, sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
WS = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(HERE))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(WS, 'protocols', 'tools'))
import slop_lint  # noqa: E402

ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument('--site', default=os.path.expanduser('~/Developer/ordenacoes-filipinas'))
ap.add_argument('--data', default=os.path.expanduser('~/Developer/ordenacoes-filipinas-workshop'))
ap.add_argument('--out', default=None, help='default: <site>/backstage/workshop.html')
args = ap.parse_args()
OUT = args.out or os.path.join(args.site, 'backstage', 'workshop.html')
STATE = json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, 'run-state.json')))
COURSE = STATE['course']
PIPE = os.path.join(args.data, 'work', 'pipeline', COURSE)
E = html.escape


def git_show(ref, path):
    r = subprocess.run(['git', '-C', args.site, 'show', f'{ref}:{path}'], capture_output=True, text=True)
    return r.stdout if r.returncode == 0 else None


def visible(page):
    t = re.sub(r'(?s)<(script|style|svg|nav)[^>]*>.*?</\1>', ' ', page)
    t = re.sub(r'(?s)<blockquote.*?</blockquote>', ' ', t)          # quotes are the sources' words, not ours
    t = html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>', ' ', t))
    return re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', t)


def rate(text, rule):
    pat = slop_lint.RATE[rule][0]
    w = len(text.split())
    return 1000 * len(re.findall(pat, text)) / w if w > 200 else None


def count_lines(p, minus=1):
    try:
        return max(0, sum(1 for _ in open(p, errors='ignore')) - minus)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return None


def fmt(n):
    return '—' if n is None else f'{n:,}'


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- course data
cmap = json.load(open(os.path.join(PIPE, 'course-map.json')))
n_lessons = len(cmap.get('lessons', cmap) if isinstance(cmap, dict) else cmap)
n_shelf = count_lines(os.path.join(PIPE, 'shelf.csv'))
chapter_files = glob.glob(os.path.join(PIPE, 'chapters', '*', '*.txt'))
n_chapters = len(chapter_files) or None
n_sources = len({os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(f)) for f in chapter_files}) or None
n_triage = count_lines(os.path.join(PIPE, 'triage.csv'))
idx = glob.glob(os.path.join(PIPE, 'compendium', '*', '00-index.md'))
n_prov = sum(max(0, sum(1 for l in open(f) if l.startswith('| ')) - 1) for f in idx)
bank = json.load(open(os.path.join(PIPE, 'exam-bank.json')))
n_q = len(bank['questions'])
n_app = sum(len(q.get('appearances', [])) for q in bank['questions'])
n_exams = len({a.get('source_file') for q in bank['questions'] for a in q.get('appearances', [])})

panels = {}
for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(PIPE, 'compendium', '*', 'panel.md')):
    v = re.findall(r'\b(APPROVED|REVISE)\b', open(f).read())
    if v:
        # every Processo plan reached writing: a second REVISE was settled by one verified author pass, so 'revised' covers it
        panels[os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(f)) + '.html'] = 'revised' if 'REVISE' in v else 'first'

front = json.loads(git_show(STATE['staging_ref'], f'tools/fronts/data/{COURSE}.json'))
# the reader's label is the study position (course blueprint C2), whatever the href or the front data says
order = [(l['href'], f'{i:02d}', l['title']) for i, l in enumerate((l for u in front['units'] for l in u['lessons']), 1)]
page_files = {p for p in (git_show(STATE['staging_ref'], f'courses/{COURSE}/') or '').split() if p.endswith('.html')}

rows = []
for href, label, title in order:
    new = git_show(STATE['staging_ref'], f'courses/{COURSE}/{href}')
    old = git_show(STATE['legacy_ref'], f'courses/{COURSE}/{href}')
    nt, ot = visible(new) if new else '', visible(old) if old else ''
    rows.append(dict(href=href, label=label, title=title, plan=panels.get(href),
                     figs=len(re.findall(r'<figure\b', new or '')),
                     words=len(nt.split()), old_words=len(ot.split()) if old else None,
                     gap=(rate(ot, 'gap-talk') if old else None, rate(nt, 'gap-talk')),
                     neg=(rate(ot, 'negated-inference') if old else None, rate(nt, 'negated-inference')),
                     next=STATE['lessons'].get(href, '')))
n_staged = sum(1 for r in rows if r['words'])
n_figs = sum(r['figs'] for r in rows)
plan_first = sum(1 for r in rows if r['plan'] == 'first')
plan_rev = sum(1 for r in rows if r['plan'] == 'revised')
reviews = [p for p in page_files if p.startswith('revisao')] or ['revisao-p1.html']

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- flight log
FL_COLS = [('prep', 'S0–S4'), ('S0b', 'S0b'), ('S5a', 'plan'), ('S5', 'write'), ('FIG', 'figures'), ('SHIP', 'ship')]
tally = {k: [] for k, _ in FL_COLS}
fl_rows = []
for line in open(os.path.join(args.data, 'FLIGHT-LOG.md')):
    if not line.startswith('| F-'):
        continue
    cells = [c.strip() for c in line.strip().strip('|').split('|')]
    fid, date, rule, applies = cells[0], cells[1], cells[-2], cells[-1]
    fl_rows.append((fid, date, rule))
    tags = {t.strip() for t in re.split(r'[,/]', applies)}
    for t in tags:
        if t in ('S0–S4', 'S0-S4', 'S0', 'S1', 'S2', 'S3', 'S4', 'S4b') or t == 'ALL':
            tally['prep'].append(fid)
        if t == 'S0b' or t == 'ALL':
            tally['S0b'].append(fid)
        if t == 'S5a' or t == 'ALL':
            tally['S5a'].append(fid)
        if t in ('S5', 'S5c') or t == 'ALL':
            tally['S5'].append(fid)
        if t == 'FIG' or t == 'ALL':
            tally['FIG'].append(fid)
        if t in ('SHIP', 'S6', 'S6b', 'S7') or t == 'ALL':
            tally['SHIP'].append(fid)
fl_latest = fl_rows[-3:][::-1]


def short_rule(r):
    r = re.sub(r'\*\*|`', '', r)
    r = re.split(r'(?<=\.)\s', r)[0].rstrip(';:, ')
    return r if len(r) < 150 else r[:147].rsplit(' ', 1)[0] + '…'


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the floor (SVG)
st = STATE['stations']
R1, R2 = 160, 420                       # belt rows
X1 = [240, 386, 532, 678, 824, 970]     # row 1 stations, left to right
BX = 1060                               # belt end; the bend's outer radius must stay inside the 1200 viewBox
X2 = [985, 845, 712, 579, 446, 318, 200]  # row 2 stations, right to left
stations1 = [
    ('S0', 'course map', f'{n_lessons} lessons', 'Sol'),
    ('S1', 'shelf', f'{fmt(n_shelf)} sources', 'Luna'),
    ('S2', 'split', f'{fmt(n_chapters)} chapters', 'Luna'),
    ('S3', 'triage', f'{fmt(n_triage)} verdicts', 'Luna xhigh'),
    ('S4', 'compendium', f'{fmt(n_prov)} provenance rows', 'script'),
    ('S4b', 'exam bank', f'{n_q} questions · {n_exams} exams', 'Luna'),
]
stations2 = [
    ('S0b', 'course blueprint', 'one object', 'Sol'),
    ('F', 'foundry', 'bench + holdout', 'Luna · Sol reads'),
    ('S5a', 'lesson plans', f'{plan_first + plan_rev} plans · {plan_rev} revised', 'Luna max · Sol panel'),
    ('S5', 'write', f'{n_staged} lessons · {n_figs} figures', 'Luna xhigh'),
    ('S6/7', 'front · reviews', f'{len(reviews)} review{"s" if len(reviews) != 1 else ""} · cartões', 'Luna · script'),
    ('S6b', 'integration', 'between lessons', 'Luna'),
    ('⇄', 'swap', 'to benecles.dev', 'one PR'),
]
state_key = {'F': 'foundry', 'S6/7': 'S6/S7', '⇄': 'swap'}
eyes = {'S0b': 'panel', 'F': 'blind read', 'S5a': 'panel', 'S6b': 'legacy triage', '⇄': 'swap read'}
gates = [((X1[3] + X1[4]) / 2, R1, 'pipeline_check'), ((X2[3] + X2[4]) / 2, R2, 'lesson floors'), ((X2[5] + X2[6]) / 2 + 6, R2, 'CI')]
pos_code = {'foundry': 'F'}.get(STATE['position'], STATE['position'])


def belt(x1, x2, y):
    a, b = min(x1, x2), max(x1, x2)
    s = [f'<line x1="{a}" y1="{y-9}" x2="{b}" y2="{y-9}" class="belt"/>', f'<line x1="{a}" y1="{y+9}" x2="{b}" y2="{y+9}" class="belt"/>']
    s += [f'<line x1="{x}" y1="{y-9}" x2="{x}" y2="{y+9}" class="roll"/>' for x in range(int(a) + 7, int(b), 14)]
    return ''.join(s)


def chevrons(xs, y, direction):
    out = []
    for a, b in zip(xs, xs[1:]):
        m = (a + b) / 2
        d = 5 if direction > 0 else -5
        out.append(f'<path d="M{m-d} {y-5} L{m+d} {y} L{m-d} {y+5}" class="chev"/>')
    return ''.join(out)


def station(x, y, code, name, out, who, state):
    cls = {'done': 'done', 'running': 'run', 'partial': 'run'}.get(state, 'wait')
    big = 'big' if len(code) <= 3 else 'mid'
    s = f'<g class="stn {cls}"><circle cx="{x}" cy="{y}" r="33"/>'
    s += f'<text x="{x}" y="{y+7}" class="code {big}">{E(code)}</text>'
    s += f'<text x="{x}" y="{y+56}" class="nm">{E(name.upper())}</text>'
    s += f'<text x="{x}" y="{y+76}" class="out">{E(out)}</text>'
    s += f'<text x="{x}" y="{y+94}" class="who">{E(who)}</text></g>'
    return s


def eye(x, y, label):
    return (f'<g class="eye"><line x1="{x}" y1="{y+14}" x2="{x}" y2="{R2-36}" class="sight"/>'
            f'<path d="M{x-17} {y} Q{x} {y-13} {x+17} {y} Q{x} {y+13} {x-17} {y} Z"/><circle cx="{x}" cy="{y}" r="4.5"/>'
            f'<text x="{x}" y="{y-20}" class="eyel">{E(label.upper())}</text></g>')


def gate(x, y, label):
    return (f'<g class="gate"><line x1="{x}" y1="{y-26}" x2="{x}" y2="{y+26}"/><circle cx="{x}" cy="{y-26}" r="3.5"/>'
            f'<text x="{x}" y="{y-36}" class="gatel">{E(label.upper())}</text></g>')


svg = ['<svg viewBox="0 0 1200 600" class="floor" role="img" aria-label="The production line: sources in, thirteen stations, five readings, three gates, a course out">']
# intake
svg.append('<g class="bin">')
for i, (lab, n) in enumerate([('syllabus', ''), ('Moodle', ''), ('books · slides', fmt(n_sources)), ('past exams', str(n_exams)), ('CPC', '')]):
    y = 92 + i * 30
    svg.append(f'<rect x="34" y="{y}" width="132" height="22" rx="2"/><text x="44" y="{y+15}" class="binl">{E(lab)}</text>'
               + (f'<text x="158" y="{y+15}" class="binn">{E(n)}</text>' if n else ''))
svg.append('<text x="34" y="78" class="side">IN</text></g>')
svg.append(belt(170, BX, R1) + chevrons([170] + X1 + [BX], R1, 1))
# the bend
ro, ri = (R2 - R1) / 2 + 9, (R2 - R1) / 2 - 9
svg.append(f'<path d="M{BX} {R1-9} A {ro} {ro} 0 0 1 {BX} {R2+9}" class="belt"/><path d="M{BX} {R1+9} A {ri} {ri} 0 0 1 {BX} {R2-9}" class="belt"/>')
svg.append(belt(140, BX, R2) + chevrons([BX] + X2 + [140], R2, -1))
# CEO catwalk
cy = R2 - 112
svg.append(f'<line x1="{X2[-1]-60}" y1="{cy}" x2="{X2[0]+40}" y2="{cy}" class="walk"/><text x="34" y="{cy+4}" class="side ceo">CEO</text>')
for (code, *_), x in zip(stations2, X2):
    if code in eyes:
        svg.append(eye(x, cy, eyes[code]))
# foundry loop
fx = X2[1]
svg.append(f'<path d="M{fx+44} {R2+12} A 46 46 0 1 1 {fx+30} {R2-35}" class="loop"/><path d="M{fx+24} {R2-41} l9 2 l-4 8" class="loop"/>')
svg.append(f'<text x="{fx+60}" y="{R2-30}" class="loopl">≤ 3 REBUILDS</text>')
for (code, name, out, who), x in zip(stations1, X1):
    svg.append(station(x, R1, code, name, out, who, st.get(code, 'wait')))
for (code, name, out, who), x in zip(stations2, X2):
    svg.append(station(x, R2, code, name, out, who, st.get(state_key.get(code, code), 'wait')))
for g in gates:
    svg.append(gate(*g))
# the course on the belt
px = dict(zip([c for c, *_ in stations2], X2)).get(pos_code, X2[1])
codes2 = [c for c, *_ in stations2]
i2 = codes2.index(pos_code) if pos_code in codes2 else 1
tx = (px + X2[min(i2 + 1, len(X2) - 1)]) / 2
svg.append(f'<g class="tray"><rect x="{tx-27}" y="{R2-16}" width="54" height="20" rx="2"/><text x="{tx}" y="{R2-2}" class="trayl">{E(STATE["course_name"].split()[0].upper())}</text>'
           f'<line x1="{tx}" y1="{R2+4}" x2="{tx}" y2="{R2+40}" class="tick"/><text x="{tx}" y="{R2+124}" class="here">here · {E(STATE["updated"][8:10])}/{E(STATE["updated"][5:7])}</text></g>')
# out
svg.append('<g class="bin">')
outs = [(f'{n_staged} lessons', ''), ('revisão', ''), ('cartões', ''), ('artigos', '')]
for i, (lab, _) in enumerate(outs):
    y = R2 + 52 + i * 26
    svg.append(f'<rect x="24" y="{y}" width="92" height="20" rx="2" class="outb"/><text x="32" y="{y+14}" class="binl">{E(lab)}</text>')
svg.append(f'<text x="24" y="{R2+40}" class="side">OUT</text></g>')
svg.append('</svg>')
floor_svg = '\n'.join(svg)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the board
def dumbbell(pair, limit, top):
    old, new = pair
    W, H, pad = 150, 22, 6
    sx = lambda v: pad + (W - 2 * pad) * min(v, top) / top
    s = [f'<svg viewBox="0 0 {W} {H}" class="db" aria-hidden="true">',
         f'<line x1="{pad}" y1="11" x2="{W-pad}" y2="11" class="axis"/>',
         f'<line x1="{sx(limit):.1f}" y1="3" x2="{sx(limit):.1f}" y2="19" class="lim"/>']
    if old is not None and new is not None:
        s.append(f'<line x1="{sx(old):.1f}" y1="11" x2="{sx(new):.1f}" y2="11" class="span {"worse" if new > old else "better"}"/>')
    if old is not None:
        s.append(f'<circle cx="{sx(old):.1f}" cy="11" r="3.5" class="old"/>')
    if new is not None:
        s.append(f'<circle cx="{sx(new):.1f}" cy="11" r="4.5" class="new {"over" if new > limit else ""}"/>')
    s.append('</svg>')
    return ''.join(s)


def num(v):
    return '' if v is None else f'{v:.1f}'


PLAN = {'first': '<span class="pl first" title="approved first time">●</span>',
        'revised': '<span class="pl rev" title="approved after a revision">◐</span>',
        'open': '<span class="pl open" title="not approved">○</span>', None: '<span class="pl none">·</span>'}
board = ['<table class="board"><thead><tr><th>#</th><th>lesson</th><th title="lesson plan panel">plan</th><th>figs</th>'
         '<th>gap talk <small>/1k · legacy → now</small></th><th>negated inference <small>/1k</small></th><th>next</th></tr></thead><tbody>']
for r in rows:
    nxt = r['next']
    ncls = 'nx ' + ('fd' if nxt.startswith('foundry') else 'rb' if nxt else '')
    board.append(f'<tr><td class="lb">{E(r["label"].replace("Aula ", ""))}</td><td class="tt">{E(r["title"])}</td><td>{PLAN[r["plan"]]}</td>'
                 f'<td class="fg">{r["figs"] or ""}</td>'
                 f'<td>{dumbbell(r["gap"], 0.5, 6)}<span class="v">{num(r["gap"][1])}</span></td>'
                 f'<td>{dumbbell(r["neg"], 0.5, 6)}<span class="v">{num(r["neg"][1])}</span></td>'
                 f'<td class="{ncls}">{E(nxt)}</td></tr>')
board.append('</tbody></table>')
board_html = '\n'.join(board)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- what the line learned
mx = max(len(v) for v in tally.values()) or 1
lw = ['<svg viewBox="0 0 1100 220" class="learn" role="img" aria-label="Flight-log rules by the station they changed">',
      '<line x1="40" y1="170" x2="1060" y2="170" class="base"/>']
cw = 1020 / len(FL_COLS)
for i, (k, lab) in enumerate(FL_COLS):
    cx0 = 40 + i * cw + 24
    ids = tally[k]
    for j, fid in enumerate(ids):
        grp, pos = divmod(j, 5)
        y = 160 - (grp // 4) * 30
        x = cx0 + (grp % 4) * 34 + pos * 6
        if pos == 4:
            lw.append(f'<line x1="{x-26}" y1="{y-14}" x2="{x+2}" y2="{y-2}" class="tally"/>')
        else:
            lw.append(f'<line x1="{x}" y1="{y-20}" x2="{x}" y2="{y}" class="tally"/>')
    lw.append(f'<text x="{cx0}" y="194" class="ll">{E(lab.upper())}</text><text x="{cx0}" y="214" class="ln">{len(ids)}</text>')
lw.append('</svg>')
learn_svg = '\n'.join(lw)
latest = ''.join(f'<li><span class="fid">{E(f)} · {E(d)}</span>{E(short_rule(r))}</li>' for f, d, r in fl_latest)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- the triage drawing (kept from the 07/10 page)
old_page = open(OUT).read() if os.path.exists(OUT) else (git_show('origin/main', 'backstage/workshop.html') or '')
m = re.search(r'(?s)<svg viewBox="0 0 1200 600" role="img" aria-label="Processo Civil triage map.*?</svg>', old_page)
triage_svg = m.group(0) if m else ''
if not triage_svg:
    cache = os.path.join(HERE, 'triage-map.svg')
    triage_svg = open(cache).read() if os.path.exists(cache) else ''
else:
    open(os.path.join(HERE, 'triage-map.svg'), 'w').write(triage_svg)

today = datetime.date.fromisoformat(STATE['updated']).strftime('%d/%m/%Y')
page = open(os.path.join(HERE, 'workshop.template.html')).read()
for k, v in {'{{DATE}}': today, '{{FLOOR}}': floor_svg, '{{BOARD}}': board_html, '{{LEARN}}': learn_svg,
             '{{LATEST}}': latest, '{{TRIAGE}}': triage_svg, '{{COURSE}}': E(STATE['course_name']),
             '{{NFL}}': str(len(fl_rows)), '{{TRIAGE_N}}': fmt(n_triage), '{{CH_N}}': fmt(n_chapters)}.items():
    page = page.replace(k, v)
open(OUT, 'w').write(page)
print(f'wrote {OUT}: {n_staged} lessons, {len(fl_rows)} flight-log rows, triage map {"kept" if triage_svg else "MISSING"}')

03The newest rules

F-035 · 14/10Do not describe what a source omits.
F-034 · 13/10Every rule a lesson tests gets one positive application and one near miss, both grounded in named source locators and planned in the blueprint.
F-033 · 09/10Evidence stays on disk; the PR carries words.
